enabled.description: Sending telemetry or not, set this argument to `false` would turn telemetry off. Defaults to `true`.

endpoint.description: Telemetry endpoint to send data to.

block.description: `modtm_telemetry` resource gathers and sends telemetry data to a specified endpoint. The aim is to provide visibility into the lifecycle of your Terraform modules - whether they are being created, updated, or deleted.
